# QML files (or one place in them: path:top|mid|end) where qmllint reports nothing for an unresolved name under any
# probe form (scripts/check-qml.sh), so their warning counts are unverifiable there. Adding a line is a review decision.

# model) is only partly analysed by qmllint 6.12 - an undefined function call in it is not flagged - and wrapping the
# type in its own file does not help. Keep that element confined to NotificationService; main.qml lost the same blind
# spot when the model moved out of it.
